This role owns the behavior and quality of AI applications, including agent architecture, orchestration, memory, model selection, evaluation, reliability, and operational tradeoffs. The role also contributes to building and scaling the AI and agent platforms that serve as a harness for non-AI engineers developing AI and agentic applications.

lists.content:
• Systems & Workflow Delivery: Build, deliver, and maintain production-grade LLM, agent, retrieval, and machine-learning workflows, product platforms, and features using structured orchestration patterns.

  • Agent Architecture & Orchestration: Design, define, and maintain agent graphs, MCPs, states, transitions, routing logic, retries, fallbacks, escalation behavior, and tool integrations using established patterns.

  • Prompt Engineering & Structured Outputs: Develop and refine comprehensive prompting strategies across system prompts, task prompts, tool instructions, response schemas, guardrails, and multi-agent interactions.

  • Memory & Context Management: Configure and design short-term state, long-term memory, conversation history, summarization, retrieval, and privacy boundaries to determine how context is retained, retrieved, or excluded.

  • Model Selection & Configuration: Select and configure appropriate models based on task requirements, capability, latency, cost, context length, operational constraints, and reliability.

  • AWS & Platform Integration: Use AWS AI services and platform capabilities—such as Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore—to build, deploy, and operate AI systems, integrating agents with tools, APIs, databases, and existing application services.

  • Retrieval & Grounding Strategies: Design robust retrieval and grounding strategies, including chunking, embeddings, ranking, metadata, filtering, and source attribution.

  • Evaluations & Testing: Create, run, and scale quantitative/qualitative evaluation suites that measure correctness, completeness, reasoning, safety, tool use, latency, grounding, and regression detection.

  • Debugging, Diagnostics & Observability: Investigate and analyze unexpected agent behavior, evaluation results, and production traces to diagnose whether failures originate in the model, prompt, state, memory, retrieval, tools, or application code. Establish monitoring and observability for AI behavior.

  • Project Ownership & Technical Leadership: Own AI projects from technical design through production deployment and ongoing improvement. Define reusable patterns and libraries that allow software engineers to build on the company's AI harness safely and consistently.

  • Software Development & Standards: Develop, test, debug, and maintain supporting application code and backend services while applying high standards for security, privacy, testing, and responsible AI.

  • Collaboration & Guidance: Collaborate closely with product, design, data science, and engineering partners to translate ambiguous problems into reliable AI capabilities, providing technical guidance and code reviews for engineers building AI-enabled features.

• 1–4 years of experience in software engineering or related fields, including 2+ years with AI, data science, or related technologies.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or a similar programming language.

  • Strong working knowledge of Node.js and JavaScript or TypeScript.

  • Demonstrated experience building and operating LLM or agentic systems in production.

  • Strong understanding of prompting, tool calling, structured outputs, agent orchestration, state management, context construction, and memory.

  • Experience designing agent graphs, multi-step workflows, routing strategies, and failure-handling behavior.

  • Experience selecting and evaluating models for different tasks and understanding quality, latency, cost, and reliability tradeoffs.

  • Practical experience with Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, or equivalent cloud AI services.

  • Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, embeddings, ranking, and grounding techniques.

  • Experience building quantitative and qualitative evaluations for LLM and agent behavior.

  • Experience using traces, logs, production data, and evaluation results to diagnose AI system failures.

  • Strong understanding of MCPs, APIs, distributed services, databases, cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, and observability.

  • Strong system design, communication, ownership, and collaboration skills.

The Carrier Relations Manager owns Entrata's insurance carrier network across our personal lines products — including HO4 renters insurance, master policy, and device/warranty insurance. This person is the primary point of contact between Entrata and our carrier and MGA partners, responsible for sourcing new markets, negotiating commercial terms, monitoring book performance, and making sure our carrier relationships stay healthy as we expand into new states and product lines. This role sits at the intersection of insurance operations, compliance, and product, and reports to Head of Insurance

lists.content:
• Own end-to-end relationships with insurance carriers and MGAs across HO4 renters, master policy, and device insurance lines

  • Source, evaluate, and onboard new carrier partners based on appetite, pricing competitiveness, and geographic coverage needs

  • Negotiate contract terms, commission schedules, and binding authority agreements with carrier and wholesale partners

  • Monitor loss ratios, retention, complaint ratios, and other book performance metrics; proactively flag and address issues before they threaten an appointment

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for carrier-side service, claims, or underwriting issues that require agency-level intervention

  • Partner with Compliance/Legal to manage state licensing, appointments, and admitted/non-admitted carrier requirements as the agency expands into new states

  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering on carrier system integrations, including rating updates, policy data feeds, and API connections

  • Track and report on carrier performance, commission accruals, and program health to leadership on a regular cadence

  • Stay current on personal lines market trends, carrier appetite shifts, and regulatory changes affecting renters, master policy, and device insurance

  • Represent Entrata at carrier and industry meetings, conferences, and renewal negotiations

• Establish, grow, and optimize strategic partnerships with insurance carriers and managing general agents.

     

  • Evaluate complex financial and operational risk data, including loss and retention ratios, to guide course of action.

     

  • Manage cross-functional alignments with technical, product, and legal units to implement carrier integrations.

     

  • Act as an internal resource and expert on personal lines insurance market changes and regulatory updates.

     

  • Ability to prioritize tasks effectively by meeting deadlines and managing workload efficiently.

     

  • Maintain professional interaction with internal and external stakeholders

• 4+ years of experience in insurance carrier management, MGA operations, or agency management, with direct experience in personal lines (renters, homeowners, or similar)

  • Demonstrated experience negotiating carrier contracts and commission agreements

  • Working knowledge of state insurance licensing and appointment requirements

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read and act on loss ratio, retention, and performance data

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent the company confidently to external carrier partners

  • Insurance license/  willing to get in first 90 days

  • Ability to manage multiple carrier relationships and competing priorities in a fast-moving environment

• 4+ years of experience in insurance carrier management, MGA operations, or agency management, with direct experience in personal lines (renters, homeowners, or similar)

  • Demonstrated experience negotiating carrier contracts and commission agreements

  • Strategic Oversight: Functions as the "Human-in-the-Loop," taking full accountability for auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations.

     

  • Data Governance: Adheres strictly to AI security protocols, ensuring no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models.

     

  • Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains.

  • Establish and monitor key payment engineering metrics, including authorization and failure rates, processing latency, settlement accuracy, exception volumes, platform availability, and incident recovery times.

  • Proven track record managing departmental budgets, strategic planning cycles, and recruiting/staffing technical teams.

  • Exceptional negotiation and influence skills with senior management and executive leadership.

  • Willingness to travel to client sites as needed.

• Specialized expertise in database management and secure coding practices focused on Money Movement, Credit Risk, and Fraud prevention.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in prompt engineering and GenAI integration, with experience auditing AI outputs for brand alignment and accuracy while safeguarding proprietary data.

lists.content:
• Deep sustainability / ESG literacy in the built environment — can explain and apply Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 concepts and calculations; fluent in ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager benchmarking requirements; conversant in Building Performance Standards (BPS), energy audits, and Retrocommissioning (RCx) reports; understands green energy / renewable procurement concepts (e.g., RECs, green tariffs, on-site generation) at a product level; familiar with GRESB, SASB (and adjacent frameworks like CRREM, LEED, local benchmarking ordinances).
  • Product management craft in B2B / proptech or utilitytech — discovery, prioritization, clear requirements/acceptance criteria, release readiness, and partnering with engineering without needing to be the engineer. Comfortable owning ambiguous 0→1 and 1→n problems.
  • Multifamily or commercial real estate utility domain awareness — utility billing, commodities, vacancy/common area vs. resident, or energy data workflows. Candidates from sustainability consulting who have sat next to operators are welcome if product muscle is strong.

• Strong working knowledge of GHG Protocol-style Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 concepts and how calculations show up in real portfolios (activity data, emission factors, location- vs market-based Scope 2, common Scope 3 categories for real estate)
  • Direct multifamily or commercial real estate operator / owner experience
  • GRESB or SASB reporting and document creation experience

• Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years in product management (or equivalent ownership) for B2B SaaS, proptech, utilitytech, or closely related domains — OR 5+ years in sustainability/energy consulting with clear evidence of shipping software products.
  • Credentials or coursework such as CEM, LEED AP, WELL, GHG accounting certificates (helpful, not required).
  • Experience with utility billing, submetering, vacancy cost recovery, or energy data platforms.
  • Experience with local benchmarking ordinances or BPS programs (e.g., major US city/state programs).

• AI Integration: Proactively leverages company-approved GenAI tools to automate routine tasks and accelerate high-value deliverables.
  • Strategic Oversight: Functions as the "Human-in-the-Loop," taking full accountability for auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations.
  • Data Governance: Adheres strictly to AI security protocols, ensuring no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models.
  • Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains.

lists.content:
• Build and maintain trusted operational partnerships with IT leadership and infrastructure teams to drive shared priorities, joint backlog execution, and aligned security practices.

  • Develop deep operational fluency and manage core workflows across the Corporate Security tool stack.

  • Reduce material corporate security risks across endpoint protection, identity hardening, data exposure, and phishing defense.

  • Establish a scalable and measurable Corporate Security operating model, standardizing processes for intake, alert triage, incident escalation, exception tracking, and leadership reporting.

  • Develop and tune high-confidence alerting mechanisms and automation to reduce noise, close visibility gaps, and optimize incident response efficiency.

  • Conduct threat hunting, vulnerability reviews, and security assessments while producing meaningful metrics, scorecards, and recommendations for executive leadership.

  • Design and operate repeatable cadences for security reporting, risk tracking, and continuous process improvement to maintain scalable security operations.

  • Oversee strategically significant projects and global initiatives to achieve milestones in threat detection and incident response.

  • Ability to prioritize tasks effectively by meeting deadlines and managing workload efficiently.

• 10+ years of experience in corporate security engineering or information security roles.

  • Direct hands-on experience with core enterprise platforms such as Sumo Logic, SentinelOne, Okta, and Google Workspace.

  • Demonstrated experience creating triage workflows, standard operating procedures, and risk intake processes.

  • Proven success managing vulnerability lifecycles, identity controls, and DLP policies alongside IT stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel to client sites as needed.

• Experience in enterprise Security Operations Centers (SOC) or specialized detection engineering roles within SaaS or tech environments.

  • Practical familiarity with User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) and integrating threat intelligence into active security workflows.

  • Direct experience securing AI/ML tooling usage while leveraging AI to accelerate operational efficiency.
